photo.title: Portrait of a Datooga man crouched next to a cold fire inside a house in a settlement 20 miles west of Katesh, Tanzania. Around his neck he is wearing strings of multicoloured beads.

Portrait of a Datooga woman sat inside a hut with gourd pots in a settlement 20 miles west of Katesh, Tanzania. She is wearing gold and ivory bracelets on her arm, gold anklets, and around her neck is a wide coiled gold collar and a variety of multicoloured bead necklaces. Her ear lobes are stretched with a gold ornamental earring and her eyes are ringed with scarification marks.

Group photograph of a white man stood with two Datooga women 20 miles west of Katesh, Tanzania. The woman on the left is wearing a hide cloak, a plant fibre skirt, blue and yellow bead necklaces and silver coil bracelets. The woman on the right is wearing an ornately decorated hide cloak with strings of multicoloured beads. Around her neck is a coiled gold collar, and she is wearing gold and ivory bracelets on her arms and legs.
View of a person stood in the doorway of a wood and mud hut in a Datooga settlement 20 miles west of Katesh, Tanzania.

Portrait of a Datooga man from 20 miles west of Katesh, Tanzania, holding a wooden club and a spear. Around his neck he is wearing a blue beaded necklace and a metal chain necklace with a fringe. His ears are pierced with an ivory plug and across his top lip is a long scarification mark.

Two women are sat in a wooden hut surrounded by gourd vessels, in a settlement north west of Mount Hanang, Tanzania. One of the women is sewing strips of hide together to form a cloth. She is wearing a grass skirt, bright blue and yellow necklaces, a gold ornamental earring and a silver coiled armlet. The other woman is wearing gold and ivory bracelets on her arm, gold anklets, and around her neck is a wide coiled gold collar and a variety of multicoloured bead necklaces. Her ear lobe is stretched with a gold ornamental earring.

Portrait of a sick Datooga person from near Katesh, Tanzania, with an open wound on the back of their neck. They are wearing a brown scarf over their head and they have two lines of scarification marks on their cheeks.

Portrait of a seated Datooga woman from 20 miles west of Katesh, Tanzania, sewing strips of hide together. She has two wide coils of silver bangles around her wrists, around her neck are a large number of blue, yellow and red bead necklaces, and her ear lobes are stretched with gold ornamental earring.

Portrait of a sick Datooga person from near Katesh, Tanzania, with an open wound on the back of their neck. They are wearing a brown scarf over their head and they have two lines of scarification marks on their cheeks.

View of a Datooga boy sat inside a hut 20 miles west of Katesh, Tanzania. The boy is grasping at the robes of a person standing up, and is surrounded by items of daily life such as pots, baskets, wooden stools and two grinding stones with ground flour. A kid goat is taking an interest in the flour on one of the stones.

Portrait of a Christian Datooga woman from Nangwa, near Katesh, Tanzania. She has distinctive scarification marks around her eyes, and is wearing colourful and patterned scarfs around her shoulders and head.

She is wearing a coiled gold collar around her neck an ivory bracelets on her wrists. Around her eyes are faint scarification marks.
